import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Derivation
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Kaehler.Polynomial
#check_failure Roth.derivative_aeval
#check_failure DerivativeAEvalNoTower.finite_support
open MvPolynomial
example {R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Fintype σ]
    (γ : σ → Polynomial R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    Polynomial.derivative (aeval γ P) =
      ∑ j, Polynomial.derivative (γ j) * aeval γ (pderiv j P) := by
  exact?
